summary: Added deterministic Idempotency-Keys (pl-<op>-<sha256[:24]>) for transfers, refunds and holds only, and retries (4 attempts, 1/2/4s or Retry-After, on ConnectionError, 429, 5xx, 409 idempotency_in_progress) per the current standard; reversals read the transfer after an uncertain failure before resending. Verified with the existing unit test and ad-hoc fake-transport checks; no new test files added.
